zh: 同一个值的所有副本排序键相同，会排在一起，所以可以先按不同的值来考虑，最后再按出现次数展开。
统计每个值的出现次数，然后对所有不同的值按“次数升序，次数相同按数值升序”排序。
用哈希表或排序后分组得到(次数, 值)，按这个二元组升序排序；依次把每个值输出“次数”遍，用空格分隔。n=0时输出空行。
en: All copies of a value have the same sort key and end up together, so you can think in terms of distinct values first and expand them by their counts at the end.
Count how many times each value occurs, then sort the distinct values by "count ascending, and value ascending for equal counts".
Get (count, value) pairs with a hash map or by grouping after sorting, and sort the pairs in ascending order; then print each value count times, separated by spaces. When n=0, print an empty line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count frequencies, sort all distinct values by (frequency, value), and expand each one by its original frequency.

## Proof of correctness

All copies of a value share the same sort key, and counting never mixes up how many times it occurs; the sort key matches the two-level priority exactly, and expanding keeps exactly the original multiset, so the result is in the required order.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
